spec.name: Locked SG12+DenseCRF, SG14 complementarity and SG15 prior-driven SPEC32 refinement
spec.track: W class-word only; no learned or released optimized tokens
spec.reliability: leave-one-out cosine of raw propagation vectors; stable call-major/head-minor tie order
spec.partition: canonical SG13/SG4 SPEC32; no partition tuning
spec.prior_threshold_policy: SG15 uses each unrefined prior's training-fold optimum; full VOC optimum frozen for COCO. Refinements never choose a new prior threshold.
spec.region_fraction_resolution: annotation resolution; native SPEC32 labels expanded nearest; prior map minmax at64 then bilinear; no boundary blur after refinement
spec.selection: unchanged training-only promotion guards; >=4/5 votes and positive selected OOF; paired forced-candidate OOF also reported
spec.validation: same-generation algebraic/control checks required; historical counts retained as drift diagnostics, never an unconditional cross-hardware gate
spec.storage: atomic per-image counts and reduced diagnostic sidecars; small representative visual caches only; no dataset-wide masks or attention

versus_W/REF.freeze_reason: fold vote and OOF guard passed

joint.freeze_reason: fold vote and OOF guard passed

voc.binary_opposite_direction_note: Two binary predictions cannot move in opposite directions from the same binary REF; that group is exactly zero. Continuous raw-map directions are recorded separately.

coco.binary_opposite_direction_note: Two binary predictions cannot move in opposite directions from the same binary REF; that group is exactly zero. Continuous raw-map directions are recorded separately.

validation: Same-generation audited controls; historical cross-hardware discrepancies are diagnostic only. Does not certify historical bit-identical reproduction.
selection_note: VOC only selects. SG15 source thresholds selected on four training folds; refined outputs inherit them. Full-VOC choices frozen before COCO metrics are interpreted. Diagnostic variants never promoted on COCO.
